question: In 2025, the Krasheninnikov Volcano erupted after several centuries, releasing a massive ash plume. In which region is this volcano located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kamchatka Peninsula**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Krasheninnikov Volcano** is located in the eastern volcanic zone of the **Kamchatka Peninsula** in the **Russian Far East**. It is part of the **Kronotsky Nature Reserve**.
 
• The volcano is a complex geological structure consisting of **two overlapping stratovolcanoes** situated within a large, ancient **caldera** measuring approximately **9 by 11 kilometers**.
 
• It was named in honor of the **18th-century** Russian explorer and geographer **Stepan Krasheninnikov**, who provided the first detailed scientific descriptions of the region in his work "Description of the Land of Kamchatka" published in **1755**.
 
• The volcano is considered **Holocene** in age, and its activity is characterized by the release of **ash plumes** and **lava flows** from its various cones.</
